message: I remember the time I decided to be the gloriously over-prepared person for a winter storm. While my neighbors were stocking up on bread and milk, I had enough soup cans to feed an army, candles that could light the whole block, and enough blankets to start a small fabric store. As the snow fell and the power flickered, I felt like the queen of cozy. Turns out, being ready for anything can turn a chilly night into a delightful adventure. Who knew that a little extra prep could lead to so much hot cocoa? ☕
